analysis.insight_summary: A user is seeking guidance on upgrading outdated PLC modules for an air compressor application. The responses provide direct replacement article numbers for both controllers and expansion modules, indicating that users often face challenges identifying migration paths between discontinued and current [product_name] hardware. This reflects broader issues with hardware lifecycle management and ensuring backward compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is expecting clear and straightforward guidance on which current [product_name] modules can serve as replacements for obsolete items, along with reassurance regarding system compatibility.
